newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TENNIS-VOINEA TO OPEN DAVIS CUP TIE AGAINST HAARHUIS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-VOINEA TO OPEN DAVIS CUP TIE AGAINST HAARHUIS.

text.p: Romanian Adrian Voinea, ranked 47th in the world, will play Dutch number two Paul Haarhuis in the opening match of their Davis Cup world group, first-round tie on Friday.
Thursday's draw selected Dutch number one Jan Siemerink to play Romanian number two Andrei Pavel in the second singles rubber on Friday.
The Netherlands' best player, Wimbledon champion Richard Krajicek, is not playing this weekend as he is still recovering from knee surgery.
"I'm satisfied with the draw," Romanian captain Florin Segarceanu told journalists. "Voinea could win the first game and this could be a good psychological factor for our team."
Dutch captain Stanley Franker said: "I'm satisfied with the draw too because Haarhuis will play in the first match so he will have time enough to rest for Saturday's doubles."
